config.script:
if not self.view.params.faceplate:
		return
	path = str(self.view.custom.fan1.path or '')
	if not path:
		return
	name = str(self.view.custom.label or '')
	title = ('%s %s' % (name, self.view.custom.fan1.member)).strip()
	# each condenser fan is a P_Motor: same typed Controls as the pumps
	shared.Alerts.showFaceplate(
		tagPath=path,
		deviceType='Pump',
		title=title,
		webGuiUrl='',
		showControls=True,
		showConfiguration=True,
		showInterlocks=True,
		showTrend=True,
		showAlarmConfiguration=True,
		showAlarms=True,
		width=560,
		height=640
	)

# Ticket Logger context-menu opener
	# page-scoped: every view on the page hears it - only the view whose menu was clicked acts
	sender = payload.get('sender')
	if sender and sender != self.view.id:
		return
	shared.Alerts.contextMenuTicketLog(payload['tagPath'], payload['viewName'])
